Cluster.description: Cluster-wide settings: domain, voter set, update policy, mesh settings
Cluster.title: Cluster

Node.description: One machine: roles, taints, OS version, system extensions, resource reservations
Node.title: Node

NodeWorkload.description: Runs on every node matching a selector
NodeWorkload.title: NodeWorkload

Service.description: Stable name, load balancing and optional public exposure
Service.title: Service

DNSZone.description: A domain kithd's DNS server answers for
DNSZone.title: DNSZone

DNSRecord.description: Names in a DNSZone: A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, SRV, NS, PTR
DNSRecord.title: DNSRecord

NetworkPolicy.description: Allow or deny traffic between workloads, namespaces and nodes
NetworkPolicy.title: NetworkPolicy

Volume.description: Storage on a node, optionally shared over the mesh
Volume.title: Volume

Blob.description: Bytes named by their BLAKE3 hash, kept on several nodes
Blob.title: Blob

Backup.description: A Volume archived on a schedule, to blobs or S3
Backup.title: Backup

Image.description: A container image made from a Volume and served by the cluster's registry
Image.title: Image

Share.description: A Volume given to machines that are not nodes, over NFS and SMB
Share.title: Share

Secret.description: Secrets, delivered as files or env vars
Secret.title: Secret

ConfigMap.description: Configuration, delivered as files or env vars
ConfigMap.title: ConfigMap

Seat.description: A group of local display, input and audio devices on a node
Seat.title: Seat

Device.description: A piece of hardware discovered on a node
Device.title: Device

DeviceClaim.description: A workload's claim on a seat or device
DeviceClaim.title: DeviceClaim

Package.description: A versioned bundle of resource templates
Package.title: Package

Release.description: An installed package with its values
Release.title: Release

Source.description: GitOps: sync resources from a git repo or OCI artifact
Source.title: Source

OSRelease.description: A signed kith OS image version
OSRelease.title: OSRelease

UpdatePlan.description: A rollout of an OSRelease across nodes
UpdatePlan.title: UpdatePlan

NodeKey.description: The wrapped key of a node's encrypted state
NodeKey.title: NodeKey

Identity.description: A user, node or workload that can call the API
Identity.title: Identity

KubeObject.description: A Kubernetes object kept as it was sent, which nothing in kith reads
KubeObject.title: KubeObject

Activity.description: What a session says its seat is doing; a seat that says nothing is idle.

every.description: How often: a number and `s`, `m`, `h` or `d` (`24h`).

copies.description: How many nodes keep each backup's blob [default: 2].

s3.description: Send them to an S3-compatible bucket instead of the cluster's blob store.

BackupSpec.description:
A Volume's directory as an archive, made every so often by the volume's node and
kept as a blob (on other nodes too) or in an S3 bucket.

copies.description: How many nodes keep a copy [default: 2].

BlobSpec.description:
Bytes kept by content: a Blob's name is the first 62 hex digits of their BLAKE3
hash, and `kith blob put` makes it.

voters.description: Names of the nodes that vote in Raft.

path.description: Dotted path into the resource, e.g. `spec.replicas`.

signedBy.description:
Public keys, one of which the image must be signed by, as `cosign sign --key`
signs: each a PEM file's text or the base64 in it (ECDSA P-256 or Ed25519).
With none, an image is run whoever made it.

pullPolicy.description: When to ask the registry what `image` points at. Defaults to `ifNotPresent`.

runAsUser.description:
The user (and group) its process is, by number. Without it: the image's own
user, or 65534 where the image names none or names 0. `0` is root: of the
container's user namespace where kithd is not root, of the node where it is.

readOnlyRoot.description:
`false`: its root file system is its own to write (what it writes is not the
image's, and goes when the container does). `true`: only volumes, /tmp and
/run are. Without it: `true`, or in a `pod` `false`.

seccomp.description: What the filter on its system calls lets through that it refuses by default.

DeviceClaimSpec.description: Exactly one of `seat` or `device`, or a `selector` over device labels.

zone.description: Name of the `DNSZone` the record is in.

name.description: The name inside the zone: `nas`, `*.apps`, or `@` for the zone itself.

values.description: One record per value. `SRV`: `priority weight port target`.

ttl.description: Seconds a resolver may keep an answer, unless a record says otherwise. Defaults to 300.

clients.description:
Split horizon: only clients in these networks (`192.168.0.0/16`, `fd00::/8`,
or one address) get this zone's answers. Empty: everyone does.

DnsZoneSpec.description: A domain kithd answers for itself instead of asking upstream.

proxyProtocol.description:
Send the backend a PROXY protocol v1 line with the client's address before the
client's bytes. Off unless true: a backend that does not expect the line breaks.

Expose.description: Public HTTPS through an edge node.

keys.description:
The public keys (hex) that count from this release on: 1 to 8, the
release's own among them if it is to go on counting.

signature.description: The release's key's signature of the handover.

proof.description: The same, by one of `keys`: someone holds a key that is handed to.

Handover.description: A release key handing over to others (`sh os/update.sh --handover`).

volume.description: The Volume, in this namespace, whose directory is the image's root.

tag.description: [default: latest] Made once for a spec: a new tag is a new image.

job.description: A Job, in this namespace, that fills the volume: the image is made when it has succeeded.

copies.description: How many nodes keep the image's blobs [default: 2].

ImageSpec.description:
A container image made in the cluster: a Volume's directory, packed by the volume's
node as the image's one layer and kept as Blobs. Every node serves it to itself as
`localhost:PORT/NAMESPACE/NAME:TAG`.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the new kind's `spec`.

controller.description:
Run by kithd for each resource of the kind: says what should exist because
of it, and its status.

admission.description:
Run by kithd before a resource of the kind is written: lets it be, changes
it or refuses it.

KubeObjectSpec.description:
What the Kubernetes API's paths keep of an object kith has no kind for (a
ServiceAccount, a Kubernetes Role): given back as it was sent, and read by nothing.

cidr.description: IPv6 ULA prefix for mesh addresses.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `.`; at most 63 characters.

revision.description:
Set by the store: 1 on creation, +1 on every change. When present in an
applied resource it must match the live revision, so a stale edit is refused.

hosts.description:
The hosts only this namespace's Services expose: a name, or `*.example.org`
for every name under one. A namespace that names any exposes no others.

selector.description: Workloads the policy applies to. Empty means the whole namespace.

id.description: What the node asks for it by: made from its disk's secret.

wrapped.description: The key, wrapped (hex). Empty once wiped.

locked.description: Not handed out while set: the node waits at its next start (`kith node lock`).

NodeKeySpec.description:
The key of a node's encrypted state partition, as the cluster holds it: wrapped
with a secret that only the node's disk has. Written by the node itself.

relay.description:
`never`: this node's traffic goes straight to the other node or not at all,
never through an edge node (which would see it). Defaults to `auto`.

extensions.description: System extensions layered on at boot.

reserved.description: Resources kept back from scheduled workloads.

unschedulable.description: Cordoned: no new workloads are placed here.

roaming.description:
It comes and goes (a laptop): it does not start to vote, peers reach it wherever
it last called from (they keep no address for it: it calls them), and what it runs
is never started elsewhere, however long it is away. Take this off a node that is
gone for good, or delete the node.

selector.description: Node labels to match. Empty means every node.

image.description: URL of the signed update file.

signature.description: Its signature of the file's header.

handover.description: The keys a node takes releases from once it runs this one.

kithVersion.description: Semver range of kith versions the package supports.

files.description:
The package itself: its files by path (`package.yaml`, `templates/web.yaml`),
as `kith package push` puts them here.

require.description: Every entry must match, e.g. `node.labels.disks: hdd`.

PortRef.description: A port by number or by name.

Preference.description: `{ weight: 50, node.labels.room: closet }`: a weight plus the labels it rewards.

PullPolicy.description: `ifNotPresent` never notices a tag that moved at the registry.

Quantity.description: An amount of CPU, memory or storage: `2`, `500m`, `2Gi`, `1.5G`.

autoUpgrade.description: Follow the version range and upgrade automatically.

publicKey.description: Key the repository's packages must be signed with.

secret.description: The Secret, in this namespace, with `accessKey` and `secretKey`.

devices.description: Names of the `Device`s grouped into this seat.

reserve.description: Slice guaranteed to whatever holds the seat.

SecretSpec.description: Kept in the store as it is given: on a node's disk it is as safe as the node's state.

selector.description: Labels of the workloads behind this service.

clients.description: Who may mount it: IPv4 addresses (`192.168.1.20`) or ranges (`192.168.1.0/24`).

uid.description: Whoever uses the share is this user on the volume's files [default: 65534, nobody].

nfs.description: Serve it over NFS 4.2 from the volume's node.

users.description: The Identities that may use it over SMB.

ShareSpec.description:
A Volume given to machines that are not nodes: over NFS by the volume's node, and
over SMB by the `nas` package's file server.

prune.description: Delete resources that are no longer in the source.

approve.description:
With `approval: manual`: the revision that may be applied (the one in
`status.pending`, as `kith source approve` puts here).

exec.description: Plain supervised processes in a cgroup.

vms.description: Virtual machines, each run by a hypervisor on the node.

confidential.description:
Run only where the processor keeps a guest's memory encrypted (AMD SEV-SNP or
Intel TDX), and only as `vms`: a node that has neither refuses it.

yieldTo.description: Hold this replica back (a sliver of one CPU) while a seat of its node is busy.

pod.description:
Run each replica as Kubernetes runs a pod: its containers share a network of
their own (any port is theirs, `localhost` is each other, and the replica has
an address on the mesh), each may write its root file system unless it says
`readOnlyRoot`, and each is the user its image names, root included (with what
a container runtime gives root, and nothing of the node's). Where kithd is not
root the replica shares the node's network.

annotations.description:
Notes on each replica, which nothing in kith reads. A replica is made anew
when they change (`kubectl rollout restart` changes one to restart them all).

Template.description: The units one replica runs: containers, exec units and virtual machines.

release.description: Name of the `OSRelease` to roll out.

selector.description: Node labels to match. Empty means every node.

maxUnavailable.description: Nodes updated at a time. Defaults to 1.

waitForIdleSeats.description: Hold back nodes with an active seat until it is idle.

allowDowngrade.description: Let nodes take a release older than the one they run. Refused otherwise.

path.description: A raw disk image on the node, by absolute path.

kernel.description: A kernel on the node, by absolute path.

firmware.description: A firmware image on the node (UEFI), for a machine that starts from a disk.

resources.description: What the hypervisor's process is held to on the node.

VmUnit.description:
A virtual machine. It starts `kernel` if there is one, or else what its firmware
finds on `disks`. Each PCI Device a DeviceClaim of the replica holds is passed
through to it (VFIO).

selector.description: Node labels the backing volume's node must have.

provision.description:
Where no Volume fits, one is made for the claim: of its name and size, on the
node that has the fewest (of those its `selector` picks). That Volume fits no
other claim and goes when the claim does; its data stays on the node, as
every Volume's does.

path.description: A local path, or a btrfs subvolume when `subvolume` is true.

shared.description: Export over the mesh so any node can mount it.

replicas.description:
Keep this many copies in all, the others on other nodes, one of which takes
over when the volume's node is lost.

sync.description: How often the other copies are brought up to date [default: 5m].

encrypted.description:
Keep it encrypted on its node's disk (dm-crypt), the key held by the cluster's
other nodes: needs a `size`, which it has from the start. Set when it is made.

wasm.description: The WebAssembly module, base64 (`kith controller set` puts a file here).

when.description: What the seat is doing while this is held back, e.g. `[fullscreen]`.
